new_jobs.description:
Description

Application deadline: Nov 28, 2026

Amazon Web Services is looking for a highly motivated and experienced Senior Solutions Architect to help accelerate cloud adoption across the Automotive and Manufacturing industry. This is an excellent opportunity to join Amazon's world-class technical teams, working with some of the best and brightest engineers, architects, and technical managers while developing your skills and furthering your career within one of the most innovative and progressive technology companies anywhere.

As a Senior Solutions Architect in the Automotive and Manufacturing (AutoMfg) vertical, you will work directly with some of the world's leading OEMs, Tier 1 suppliers, and industrial manufacturers as they reimagine how vehicles are designed, built, and operated and how factories of the future come to life. You will serve as a trusted technical advisor, helping customers navigate complex architectural decisions across connected vehicle platforms, autonomous driving workloads, digital twins, smart factory/Industry 4.0 initiatives, supply chain optimization, and software-defined vehicle (SDV) strategies.

We are looking for individuals who are motivated by the opportunity to work backwards from customer needs and help them gain competitive advantage using AWS. As an experienced technologist and key member of the Account Team, you will influence customers' architectural choices across broad use cases involving IoT, edge computing, high-performance computing (HPC), security, data lakes and analytics, AI/ML, simulation, and robotics — as well as foundational services spanning compute, storage, and networking.

You will provide exceptional technical design guidance and thought leadership, lead efforts to capture and share best-practice knowledge with the broader AWS Solutions Architecture community, and develop reusable industry reference architectures. You will also have the opportunity to learn from, collaborate with, and educate some of the brightest technical minds in the industry today across the breadth of enterprise and operational technology architecture.

Key job responsibilities

Own the technical relationship with key Automotive and Manufacturing accounts, acting as the primary technical point of contact and trusted advisor to C-suite, VP-level engineering leaders, and senior technical stakeholders.

Architect and design scalable, secure, and cost-effective cloud solutions for industry-specific workloads including connected vehicle data platforms, ADAS/AD simulation pipelines, digital twin environments, MES/SCADA cloud integration, predictive maintenance, and smart factory deployments.

Bridge IT and OT — bring a unique ability to connect traditional enterprise IT architectures with operational technology (OT) environments on the shop floor, at the edge, and in the vehicle, leveraging AWS IoT, edge, and hybrid services.

Drive technical strategy by developing and executing technical account plans aligned with customers' business objectives and digital transformation roadmaps.

Lead proof-of-concept engagements and architectural reviews (including Well-Architected Reviews) to accelerate customer adoption and derisk production deployments.

Influence product roadmaps by partnering closely with AWS service teams (e.g., IoT, AI/ML, Graviton, Outposts, Wavelength) to relay customer requirements and advocate for industry-specific feature development.

Develop and scale industry thought leadership — create reference architectures, whitepapers, blog posts, and re-usable technical assets for the AutoMfg vertical. Present at AWS events (re:Invent, Summits, industry conferences) and customer executive briefings.

Collaborate cross-functionally with Account Managers, Partner Solutions Architects, Professional Services, ISV/SI partners, and AWS specialist teams to deliver comprehensive solutions.

Mentor and elevate other Solutions Architects within the team, contributing to technical community development through knowledge sharing, bar-raising, and best-practice codification.

Think strategically about business, product, and technical challenges — connect the dots between industry megatrends (electrification, SDV, Industry 4.0, sustainability) and AWS capabilities.

Basic Qualifications

8+ years of IT and/or Management Consulting, or 8+ years of technology sales experience
5+ years of in design/implementation/operations/consulting with distributed applications experience
Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science or other technical degree or related experience
Experience communicating complex information and solutions to senior stakeholders and influencing decisions
Experience in at least one of these technology areas: DevOps, serverless, software development and design, CI/CD, AI/ML, Storage, Networking or Databases
Experience in written and verbal communication with the ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to executives and non-technical leaders

Preferred Qualifications

3+ years of solving problems with technology in the Automotive & Manufacturing industries experience
Experience working with transformative technologies including cloud, IoT, business intelligence, and analytics
Experience with preventive maintenance procedures, industrial electrical, industrial controls, and industrial electronics & robotics
Knowledge of current industry standards
Experience working in the Automotive and/or Manufacturing industry in a sales, business development or partner capacity

Link Solutions is seeking a Principal Solutions Architect
to join our team in supporting our strategic growth initiatives and enterprise capability development in McLean, VA.

U.S. citizen
Ten years experience leading technical solution development for large, complex federal pursuits

will play a key leadership role in designing innovative, mission-driven solutions that help our customers solve complex challenges across the federal and defense sectors. Your insights and technical leadership will directly support high-priority pursuits, corporate growth objectives, and the advancement of next-generation solutions for our customers.

Lead the development of innovative, compliant, and executable technical solutions supporting strategic federal and defense opportunities.

Support the evolution of our company's technical capabilities, service offerings, and strategic technology roadmaps.

Develop reusable solution components and standardized approaches that improve delivery efficiency, scalability, and competitive positioning.
Provide technical leadership across cloud, cybersecurity, AI/ML, automation, DevSecOps, digital modernization, and enterprise IT transformation initiatives.
Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend practical applications aligned with customer missions and business priorities.
Communicate complex technical concepts to executives, engineers, customers, and non-technical stakeholders.
Represent the company as a trusted technical advisor during customer engagements, technical exchanges, oral presentations, and strategic growth activities.

Ten (10+) years of experience in solutions architecture, enterprise architecture, systems engineering, or related technical leadership roles.
Demonstrated experience leading technical solution development for large, complex federal pursuits.
Experience supporting DoD, Navy, Federal Civilian, or other federal agency environments.

Deep familiarity with enterprise technologies, cloud ecosystems, cybersecurity principles, DevSecOps practices, data architectures, and emerging technology trends.
Experience collaborating with capture, proposal, business development, and operational teams in a federal contracting environment.
Experience developing differentiated technical approaches and competitive solution strategies.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to engage executive leadership, customers, and technical teams.

new_jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer, Target Triage
new_jobs.description:
At GSK, we see a world in which advanced applications of machine learning and AI will allow us to develop novel therapies for existing diseases and respond quickly to emerging or changing diseases with personalized drugs, driving better outcomes at reduced cost and with fewer side effects. It is an ambitious vision that will require the development of products and solutions at the cutting edge of machine learning and AI. If that excites you, we’d love to chat.

Job Purpose:

The AI/ML Controllable Biology Team applies machine learning and AI methods to biological networks and sequence data from large-scale human genetic, functional genomic, and single-cell experiments. Models that control biological networks have the potential to be transformative in drug discovery, empowering us to find new life-saving medicines.

We are looking for a Staff AI/ML Engineer – Controllable Biology. Competitive candidates will have a track record of developing SOTA deep learning models to solve challenging real-world scientific problems. You should be an outstanding scientist with in-depth knowledge of modern machine learning. You can convert vaguely described biological and drug discovery challenges into well-defined machine learning problems. You can independently execute and deliver full AI/ML-driven solutions end to end: sourcing training data, designing and implementing SOTA machine learning models, defining metrics and benchmarks, and shipping stable, tested, performant code and services in an agile environment.

The AI/ML team is built on the principles of ownership, accountability, continuous development, and collaboration. We hire for the long term, and we're motivated to make this a great place to work. Our leaders will be committed to your career and development from day one.

Key Responsibilities:

As a Staff AI/ML Engineer - Controllable Biology you will:

Convert complex biological questions into tractable mathematical problems that can be solved by modern computational methods.
Be adept at decomposing large problems into quarterly, measurable results and consistently working towards delivering these through engineering sprints.
Be a technical mentor in a multidisciplinary engineering team, including delegating tasks to junior colleagues and guiding them through delivery, while fostering an inclusive, supportive team culture.
Be comfortable demoing early and often, balancing research and engineering velocity.
Be a standard-bearer for machine learning, software engineering, code review and agentic development best practices within the organisation.
Define technical strategy and roadmaps for AI/ML products, balancing scientific needs, safety, and operational reliability.
Operate in a transparent way, communicating clearly and accurately to leadership and the broader organisation.
Partner with stakeholders to ensure models are explainable, safe, and relevant.

Basic Qualifications:

Master’s degree in a related field (e.g. computer science, mathematics or natural sciences).
7+ years’ experience with standard deep learning algorithms, model architectures, machine learning best practices, scalable training and deployment.
7+ years’ experience in software development, including code reviews, version control systems, CI/CD pipelines, software testing, technical documentation and Agile delivery methodologies.
5+ years’ experience in a technical lead or engineering manager role with direct reports, mentoring software engineers or machine learning practitioners.
7+ years’ experience with Python and PyTorch, or an equivalent machine learning framework.
Experience working with biological sequence and network data, including genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, gene regulatory networks or related biological datasets.
Experience collaborating with stakeholders across multiple teams, functions and geographic regions.

Preferred Qualifications:

If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus:

PhD in a quantitative or computational field.
Background in modelling disease biology, systems biology, molecular biology and biochemistry.
Track record of delivering high-quality, research-level machine learning and robust software solutions.
Peer-reviewed publications in major AI conferences.

Work Arrangements:

The role is hybrid, requiring on-site work 2 days per week. Remote or fully home-working arrangements are not available for this role.

Skills

Artificial Intelligence (AI), Artificial Intelligence Ethics, Artificial Neural Networks (ANNS), Classification Models, Deep Learning, Intelligent Automation (IA), Machine Learning (ML), Model Evaluation, Predictive Modeling, Python (Programming Language), Test Documentation

If you are based in Cambridge, MA; Waltham, MA; Rockville, MD; or San Francisco, CA, the annual base salary for new hires in this position ranges $200,475 to $334,125. The US salary ranges take into account a number of factors including work location within the US market, the candidate’s skills, experience, education level and the market rate for the role. In addition, this position offers an annual bonus and eligibility to participate in our share based long term incentive program which is dependent on the level of the role. Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. new_jobs.description:
Overview

Keysight is a mission-critical design enablement partner for organizations solving the world’s most complex engineering challenges. With deep engineering expertise and leading design, emulation, and test solutions, our ~16,800 employees help customers in over 100 countries accelerate innovation across communications, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace and defense, semiconductor, and artificial intelligence markets. Learn more about what we do.

At Keysight, people come together to explore new ideas, challenge what's possible, and advance the technologies defining the future. Here, you'll find opportunities to do your best work, take your career further, and thrive in an award-winning culture. Learn more about our benefits.

Software & AI Labs is seeking a Senior Applied Machine Learning Engineer to serve as technical lead for the Models & Data Science program at Keysight headquarters in Santa Rosa. The program develops the core AI/ML models behind Keysight’s design, simulation, calibration, and measurement solutions. The technical lead will set technical direction for model development and own the path from prototype models to production. This senior individual contributor role requires industry experience productizing ML models, hands-on technical depth, and leadership through influence across engineering and product teams. Our Engineering organisation is scaling its AI Engineering capabilities under new leadership, creating an opportunity to shape the next generation of AI at Rapid7. You’ll tackle our most complex technical challenges, establish architectural principles and engineering standards, and drive greenfield innovation that delivers meaningful impact for our global customers. Through technical leadership and mentoring, you’ll shape strategic product and platform investments and influence how we build and scale AI across Rapid7.

About The Team

Rapid7's AI Engineering team builds the AI that powers our security platform. We are AI engineers and applied scientists who take models from research to production, combining open-source and frontier LLMs, AI agents, and fast predictive models with more than 20 years of Rapid7 security expertise. Our work drives core use cases across Detection and Response, such as alert triage, threat investigation, and automated response, and Exposure and Remediation, such as vulnerability prioritization, attack surface risk assessment, and guided remediation. Together, these help customers stop threats faster and fix what matters most.

About The Role

As a Senior Principal AI Engineer, you will set the company-wide technical direction for how Rapid7 builds, adapts, and serves its own models. You will own the strategy that decides which problems we solve with open-source models we fine-tune and post-train ourselves versus frontier models, and you will shape the platform, hiring, and investment that make that strategy work. You are the technical authority across teams and stay hands-on with the hardest problems, from training runs to inference performance. Specifically your focus will be to:

Define the multi-year architecture and technical roadmap for Rapid7's model, training, and inference platform across Detection and Response and Exposure and Remediation
Own model strategy at the company level: when to use frontier or open-source models, and when to fine-tune, distill, or post-train, with clear cost, quality, and risk trade-offs
Lead the design of fine-tuning and post-training systems, including LoRA and full fine-tuning, distillation, and preference or RL-based methods
Drive inference efficiency at scale, including batching, caching, quantization, speculative decoding, and parallelism, balancing quality, latency, and cost
Set the build-versus-buy and capacity strategy for GPU infrastructure, training and serving stacks, and cloud spend
Establish evals as the release gate for every AI system we ship, and set the benchmarks that define "good" for security models and agents
Set engineering standards for experimentation, reproducibility, model lifecycle management, and context engineering across teams
Lead design reviews and resolve the hardest cross-team technical trade-offs
Mentor Principal, Staff, and Senior engineers, influence hiring, and shape product and platform investment

The Skills And Qualities You’ll Bring Include

15+ years of software or ML engineering experience, including 3+ years optimizing and fine-tuning open-source LLMs in production
A track record of architecting AI systems used across multiple teams or products, with measurable impact on quality, latency, or cost
Open-source models: deep expertise with open-source LLMs and PyTorch
Fine-tuning and post-training: LoRA and full fine-tuning, distillation, and preference or RL-based methods
Training infrastructure: experience with distributed training (FSDP, DeepSpeed, or similar) on multi-GPU clusters
Inference optimization: deep knowledge of serving at scale with vLLM or SGLang, including batching, caching, and quantization
Evals: defining evaluation strategy and benchmarks for LLM and agent systems
Strong distributed systems and Python fundamentals
Takes accountability for organisation-wide technical outcomes, proactively addressing systemic risks and removing barriers to delivery while ensuring technical decisions align with strategic priorities
An influential communicator who can articulate complex architectural trade-offs, build consensus and influence technical and product decisions across the organisation
Builds alignment across Engineering, Product and other functions on technical direction, driving decisions that shape product and platform investments.
Anticipates evolving customer needs and shapes AI architecture and technical strategy to maximise customer value, making informed trade-offs between capability, performance, cost and scalability to guide product and platform investment
Thrive in ambiguity at the leading edge of AI, driving change and focusing forward as the technology and the threat landscape evolve
Recognition as an expert in AI, evidenced by publications, patents, open-source contributions or industry engagement
Embody our core values to foster a culture of excellence that drives meaningful impact and collective success

Preferred Skills And Experience Include

A strong history of organization-wide impact through technical leadership, mentoring, and shared platforms and standards
Security domain experience, such as detection engineering, SOC/MDR, or vulnerability management
Experience with GPU kernels or compilation tools (CUDA, Triton, TensorRT-LLM)
Experience with RL environments and reward design for agentic or tool-using models
Experience running AI workloads on AWS at scale, with a focus on cost efficiency
Ability to explain technical trade-offs to engineering, product, and leadership audiences
Publications, patents, or open-source contributions in AI

We know that the best ideas and solutions come from multi-dimensional teams. That’s because these teams reflect a variety of backgrounds and professional experiences. If you are excited about this role and feel your experience can make an impact, please don’t be shy - apply today.

At Rapid7, our vision is to create a secure digital world for our customers, our industry, and our communities. new_jobs.title: AI Engineer
new_jobs.description:
About LearnVector

For most of history, great teaching has been scarce. A brilliant teacher who knows you well, adapts to how you learn, and patiently stays with you until you get there — almost no one has had that. AI changes what's possible. LearnVector, founded by Andrew Ng, is building a trustworthy AI guide for learning, with a mission to accelerate human development. We're a small, fast-moving team working on-site in Mountain View, California and backed by a $100 million investment from Coursera.

About The Role

The AI Engineer will build the agentic systems at the core of the product: systems that understand each learner, plan a path with them toward skills worth having, and work with them step by step until they get there.

This is not a wrap-an-API role. The hard problems are the ones frontier models don't solve on their own: maintaining an accurate picture of a learner over weeks and months, deciding what to teach next and when to hold back, keeping long-running conversations useful rather than merely pleasant, and verifying that generated teaching is correct before a learner ever sees it. You'll own systems end to end — design, implementation, evaluation, and iteration against real learner data.

What You Will Do

Design and build the agentic core: multi-step tutoring loops, tool use, memory, and planning over long-horizon learner relationships
Build the learner model — the evolving, evidence-backed representation of what each learner knows, wants, and responds to — and the systems that read and write it
Build evaluation harnesses for conversational quality and teaching quality, and use them to drive iteration; define what "this session taught something" means operationally and measure it
Design guardrails and verification layers so generated content and tutor claims meet a bar a trusted brand requires
Work daily with the founding team, including Andrew, on the hardest product questions: what should an AI tutor do, and how do we know it's working?

What You Bring

AI-native: you default to AI-assisted coding and building agentic automations in everything you do, you have an appetite for and record of experimenting with the newest AI engineering practices
Experience as a software engineer, with substantial hands-on work building with LLM APIs (Claude, OpenAI, or similar): agentic workflows, tool use, structured output, long-context and memory patterns
Experience shipping and operating LLM systems in production, including evaluating them - you have opinions about evals because you've built them
Strong Python and/or TypeScript/Node engineering skills; comfort owning services end to end
Ability to turn a fuzzy product question ("is the tutor actually helping?") into a measurable system, and ship without heavy oversight

Nice to haves

Experience with conversational AI products, tutoring systems, or long-running assistant relationships
Background in recommendation, personalization, or user-modeling systems
Familiarity with the education or learning-science landscape
Experience with voice interfaces or real-time interaction

What Success Looks Like

In your first 30 days, you will have shipped a measurable improvement to the core tutoring loop and stood up an evaluation that tells us whether it worked.

In your first 6 months, the agentic core — learner model, planning, verification — will be a durable system the whole product builds on, with quality metrics the team trusts and a cadence of improvement driven by real learner data.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation at any point in the application or interview process, we'll work with you. Requests are kept confidential and separate from hiring decisions.

new_jobs.description:
About The Role

As a Forward Deployed Engineer on our Applied AI Inference team, you’ll be the hands-on technical owner for a broad set of fast-growing customers building products on high-quality open models at scale. You’ll work across several customers and get into the details of how each customer selects and applies models in their workload, from evals and prompts to agents and harness integrations.

You’ll go deep technically. You’ll learn each customer’s architecture and use cases well enough to guide their move from closed to open models. That means choosing the right models, benchmarking quality and performance, tuning prompts and pipelines, and integrating models into their systems and workflows. You’ll write code most days, alongside customers and in our own tools.

You’ll own customer outcomes from post-POC to production. Once a Solutions Architect wins the proof of concept, you take the account into production and help it scale. You drive adoption, remove blockers and proactively make sure the customer gets the value they were promised.

You’ll bring a product mindset. You’ll turn what you learn on each deployment into reusable playbooks, tooling, reference architectures and product feedback so each new deployment is faster and needs less manual work than the last.

You’ll work across teams constantly. You’ll work alongside Solutions Architects, Sales, Engineering, Product, and Research.

As one of the early members on this team, you’ll also help define how the function runs, including its playbooks, tooling and hiring. Your work will directly affect customer retention, platform adoption and company growth.

Responsibilities

Opinionated Onboarding: Plan the path to production with the SA and customer, and make sure the right deployment strategy, model choice, ramp plan and monitoring are in place before the workload goes live.
Model Selection & Migration: Help customers move from closed to open models. Evaluate options on the customer’s own data, pick the right model, and handle upgrades and deprecations without regressions.
Agent Design: Build and debug agents and multi-step workflows that hold up in production, including tool calling, planning and retries.
Harness & System Integrations: Get Together working inside the tools customers already use, like coding-agent harnesses, agent frameworks, OpenAI-compatible SDKs and data pipelines. Fix what breaks between them: tool-call formats, streaming, context limits and rate limits.
Evals & Prompts: Build evals that measure what each customer cares about, and use them to tune prompts and catch regressions.
Customer Touchpoints: Proactively monitor your accounts, keep a frequent pulse of how things are going, work closely alongside customers to ensure adoption and success.
Automation & Tooling: Write automation, monitoring, scripts and internal tools that turn repeatable work into systems, for customers and for our own team.
Product Feedback Loop: Bring what you see in the field to Engineering and Product, contribute product enhancements and documentation, and turn recurring patterns into playbooks the whole team can reuse.

Requirements

Experience: 4+ years in a technical, customer-facing engineering role such as forward deployed engineering, solutions engineering, applied AI engineering or ML infrastructure, ideally at a fast-growing company. You can own these accounts from day one.
Agent Design: You’ve built agents with tool use and run them in production, and you can tell which harness or framework fits a given workload.
Model Selection: You know today’s open models well and have compared open and closed models on a real workload. You can explain your pick in terms of quality, latency and cost.
Automation & Coding: Strong Python. You’ve built tools and automation that other people use, and you lean on AI tools to get your own work done faster.
Applied AI & Integrations: You’ve shipped LLM features into existing products, ideally coding or agentic use cases, and debugged what broke between the model, the SDK and the app.
Prompt Engineering: You’ve written and evaluated prompts for production LLM applications.
Ownership & Judgment: You can juggle many accounts, turn vague goals into clear plans, and know when to go deep, when to automate and when to bring in a specialist.
Communication: You can explain technical tradeoffs clearly to engineers and business stakeholders.Builder Mindset: You’re excited to help build a new team from the ground up.

About Together AI

Together AI, the AI Native Cloud, is purpose-built for AI engineers. AI application developers get high-performance inference that scales reliably, fine-tuning and reinforcement learning for creating frontier-level specialized models, and pre-training at massive scale for fully custom intelligence, all around a marketplace of leading open models that teams can run, adapt, and own. Trusted by Cursor, Decagon, ElevenLabs, Salesforce, and Zoom, Together serves 400+ trillion tokens a month.

new_jobs.description:
Company Description

Software should help a business move as one. But too often, disconnected systems, scattered data, and fragmented workflows get in the way.

Freshworks is building a better way:
AI-powered, unified service operations that turn complexity into coordinated action. Our platform brings together people, AI, data, and workflows so IT and service teams can anticipate what matters, act faster, and keep the business moving forward together. Organizations including Bridgestone, McLaren, New Balance, S&P Global, and Sony Music trust Freshworks to power the services their employees and customers depend on every day.

We bring that same belief in coordinated action to how we work by giving people the ownership to make bold moves at speed, and a team that moves with them.

Job Description

We are building the operating system for go-to-market

This means using AI to help Freshworks understand and act on buyer signals across the full revenue engine. That includes web behavior, for fills, trial activity, intent data, enrichment, account research, meeting transcripts, campaign engagement, and sales activity.

This is an engineering role inside a revenue organization. You will build agents, automations, alerts, data pipelines, and internal tools that help teams move faster and work with better context.

You will build production systems that help marketing and sales prioritize accounts, personalize outreach, route work, surface insights, and reduce manual effort across the buyer journey.

You will have executive support, real production problems, and a clear mandate to define what an AI-native revenue engine looks like across web, marketing, sales, and operations.

What You'll Do

Build AI-powered GTM workflows.Design and deploy workflows across lead management, account research, routing, scoring, prioritization, personalization, seller briefings, and follow-up support
Turn buyer signals into action.Build systems that help Freshworks detect, enrich, prioritize, and act on high-value buyer activity across the funnel.
Create the tool layer for GTM agents.Integrate tools like Salesforce, Clay, Marketo, Relevance, Claude Code, sales engagement platforms, web analytics, enrichment providers, and internal data sources.
Engineer context pipelines.Bring together data from web activity, intent providers, product usage, firmographics, technographics, meetings, email engagement, and CRM history.
Build intelligent alerts and recommendations.Create systems that notify teams when important buyer activity happens. This could include target account engagement, key persona activity, competitor mentions, buying committee movement, or stalled follow-up.
Move prototypes into production.Take working ideas and harden them with authentication, logging, metrics, retries, error handling, alerting, documentation, and cost controls.
Partner across the revenue engine.Work with Web, MarketingOps, Sales Ops, Demand Gen, RevOps, SDR and BDR teams, and Engineering to turn business needs into scalable systems.

Qualifications

What We're Looking For

Engineering experience working with complex systems, varied datasets, and data-driven productivity tools
Experience as a software engineer, automation engineer, GTM engineer, AI engineer, ML engineer, or technical revenue systems builder
Hands-on experience building AI or LLM-powered applications, automations, or workflows
Strong technical skills with APIs, webhooks, OAuth, queues, retries, and system integrations
Experience integrating CRM systems, marketing automation tools, enrichment tools, sales engagement platforms, lead sources, GitHub, and internal data sources
Experience with tools or patterns like Claude, OpenAI, Relevance, Clay, MCP, function calling, structured outputs, LangGraph, or custom orchestration
Experience building automations for lead management, prospecting, routing, qualification, prioritization, or revenue operations
Strong understanding of inbound and outbound motions
Ability to translate revenue team needs into technical solutions
Experience with evals, monitoring, observability, or quality controls for AI systems
Strong program ownership in ambiguous environments
Clear communication with technical and non-technical partners

Additional Information

Please note this is a hybrid role with onsite expectations of 3x/week (Tues - Thurs) from our San Mateo, CA headquarters.

The annual base salary range for this position is $202,000 - $250,000.
This role is also eligible for a target bonus.

Compensation is based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to location, experience, job-related skills, and level.

Freshworks offers multiple options for dental, medical, vision, disability, and life insurance. Equity + ESPP, flexible PTO, flexible spending, commuter benefits, and wellness benefits are also offered. Freshworks also offers adoption and parental leave benefits.

new_jobs.title: Applied Researcher, Vision & Video Foundation Models
new_jobs.description:
About Us

At Archetype AI, we’re building the world’s first physical AI platform to bring artificial intelligence into the real world. Our foundation model, Newton, understands the physical world through objective sensor data and generates real-time insights into complex physical behaviors, from industrial machinery and systems to wearable devices and smart environments.

Formed by a high-caliber team from Google and backed by one of Silicon Valley’s most renowned venture funds, Archetype AI is at Series A and rapidly advancing its technology for the next big leap. This is a unique opportunity to join an exciting, fast-growing AI team based in the heart of Silicon Valley.

About The Role

We are looking for an Applied Researcher to lead vision and video research for Newton, our multimodal foundation model for the physical world. Today’s vision and video foundation models still struggle with temporal understanding, physical reasoning, robustness, and generalization to cluttered industrial scenes, and these remain open research problems.

In this role, you will set the research agenda for visual understanding in our multimodal models: identify where current models fail, form hypotheses, design and run experiments, and publish your results. Your work will also be deployed at customer sites in models for detection, tracking, counting, activity recognition, and complex video understanding.

What You’ll Own

Lead research on vision and video understanding in our multimodal foundation models, fusing visual signals with sensor, language, and audio data.
Develop new architectures, representation learning methods, and training strategies for image, video, and vision-language understanding.
Diagnose failure modes of current models and design rigorous experiments that drive measurable gains in performance, generalization, and robustness.
Own the full research cycle, from data preparation and training to evaluation and analysis.
Publish research at top-tier venues and represent Archetype AI in the research community.
Partner with engineering to turn research results into production models for detection, tracking, counting, and activity recognition.

Key Qualifications

PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related field, or a Master’s degree with equivalent research experience.
5+ years of research experience in computer vision, video understanding, or multimodal machine learning, including PhD research.
Track record of original research in vision, video, or multimodal learning, from hypothesis through published results.
Publications at top-tier venues such as CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICML, or ICLR, and the ability to keep publishing.
Deep expertise in modern vision foundation, video, or vision-language models, including architectures, representation learning, and large-scale training.
Strong scientific rigor: forms hypotheses, designs experiments, and draws sound conclusions in ambiguous problem spaces.
Proficiency in Python and deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch.

Nice to Have

Experience taking research models into production.
Multimodal learning beyond vision-language, such as video combined with sensor, time-series, or audio data.
Temporal modeling or physical-world understanding, including dynamics, events, and interactions over time.

Benefits

Hybrid schedule in San Mateo, 3 days per week (Tuesday, Wednesday and Friday)
Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
401(k) retirement plan.
Flexible PTO.

new_jobs.title: Founding Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)
new_jobs.description:
About StackOne

StackOne is the integration infrastructure for AI agents. Backed by GV and Workday Ventures ($24M raised), we make it possible for any AI agent — whether our customers build it into their product or buy it off the shelf — to take real action across the enterprise stack. Our platform gives agents 630+ connectors and 43,000+ pre-built actions, an AI connector builder for everything not covered yet, and the production layer agents actually need: semantic tool discovery that cuts token use by up to 80%, managed authentication and per-action permissions, the most accurate prompt injection defense on the market, and end-to-end observability.

Join us on our fast trajectory to build the future of agentic integrations.

About The Role

We're hiring our first Forward Deployed Engineer
to help our customers decide where AI agents will make a measurable difference to their business, and then make sure it happens.

You'll sit with executives and their teams, learn how the business runs day to day, and turn that into an AI strategy and rollout plan tied to the number they care about, whether that's hours saved, cost per process or revenue. You'll design the agents, guide our Solutions Engineers as they build them, and stay with the customer until the agreed results are in. We're starting with healthcare, our fastest-growing vertical. Knowing its systems, its data and its compliance rules will be a big part of the job.

You'll report to our CEO & Co-Founder, and work from our San Mateo office 1 to 2 days a week, with regular travel to customer sites across the US.

What You’ll Be Doing

Run discovery with C-level leaders, managers and their teams: walk through their processes, map workflows and data, and find what AI agents can automate or improve.
Build a strategy and rollout plan for each customer, tied to the metric their business cares about, and present it to their leadership.
Design the agents, skills and plugins that deliver the plan, including inside tools like Microsoft Copilot, Glean and Gemini Enterprise, and steer the Solutions Engineers who build and maintain them.
Track impact once agents are live, with dashboards that show the time saved or the metric agreed with the customer.
Scope and price consulting engagements, and grow each account from the first phase to the next as customers adopt more of StackOne.
Join our most strategic deals before the sale to run consultative workshops, often onsite.
Become our go-to expert in healthcare: the systems and APIs worth connecting, HIPAA and BAA scope, and where patient data lives.
Bring what you learn back to Product, and decide what should become a connector, feature or template.
Build our reputation in the vertical through talks, white papers, case studies and community work.

What We're Looking For

Experience advising clients on strategy, as a consultant, solutions architect or product manager, ideally across several companies adopting AI. The title matters less than the work you've done with customers.
Hands-on experience building and deploying AI agents (with agent SDKs or via low code platforms), and ways of optimising and measuring accuracy & efficiency of agentic workflows, enough to judge what's worth building and to review someone else's build. You check what AI-generated work actually does before anyone relies on it.
Healthcare experience: you understand how providers, payers or labs work, which systems they run on, and the compliance rules around their data.
Executive presence. You present to C-level with confidence, listen well, and write a proposal a CEO will sign.
A commercial mindset: you tie a technical plan to revenue, savings or growth, and you can price the work.
Strong organisation, with follow-up that customers and colleagues can count on.
Low ego and high initiative. You come up with ideas, share credit, and help the people around you understand why the work matters.
Comfort working on your own as the first person in a new role, ideally with experience in early-stage or fast-growing startups.
Based in the Bay Area, happy to travel to customer sites, and happy to start early some days to overlap with our London team.

Nice to have: built agents for customers in an AI agent framework, Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, Glean or Gemini Enterprise or similar; healthcare IT experience such as EHR integrations (Epic, Oracle Health), FHIR, HL7 v2, LIMS, or claims and billing systems; hands-on API work (REST, webhooks, OAuth) in Python or TypeScript; experience leading a team or a vertical; talks or writing on AI adoption.

Dealbreaker:
no experience advising clients at a senior level, or no hands-on experience building with AI.

Our Stack

We're pragmatic about tooling. Today's stack includes:

AI tools our customers roll out: Microsoft Copilot, Glean, Gemini Enterprise, Claude.
Agent frameworks our customers use: OpenAI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, Pydantic AI, LangChain, CrewAI.
Agent protocols: MCP, A2A and common agent optimisations (code mode, RLM).
Infrastructure & monitoring: AWS, Cloudflare, Kubernetes, Pydantic, Datadog.
Languages: TypeScript (Node.js) and Python.
How we build: coding agents (Claude Code, Codex etc.), with skills, plugins and agentic automations/internal agents we maintain ourselves.

Benefits

Join one of the best-funded, fastest-growing startups in the AI infrastructure ecosystem.
Work alongside an experienced team, with backgrounds from Google, Microsoft, Oracle, Coinbase, JP Morgan, and more.
Meaningful share options — share in the company's success as we grow.
25 days PTO + 1 additional day per year of tenure.
Up to 30 days per year working from abroad, with optional co-working space paid for from your remote setup allowance.
Health insurance.
401(k).
Remote-first, with regular in-person time in the Bay Area.
$1,000 for your home office setup + $500/year top-up.
Annual team offsites to sunny spots (last ones were in Croatia and Portugal ☀️)

Ready to help us change the game for SaaS integrations? Get in touch and let's chat!

We believe diversity drives innovation. We encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply. As an equal-opportunity employer, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

new_jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Role

As an Applied AI Architect on the Technology Partnerships team at Anthropic, you will be the technical lead for strategic ISV and technology partners building unique product integrations with Claude. These are software companies whose platforms are systems of record for their customers, and who want those customers to be able to work with their data and workflows directly inside Claude.

This role goes deep with each partner. You will own the technical side of product partnerships from first scoping through launch and beyond. You will help partners design how their platform shows up in Claude (MCP servers, connectors, plugins, and skills), hold the quality bar through evaluations, and act as the bridge between the partner's product and engineering teams and Anthropic's Product, Engineering, and Research teams. You will be a trusted technical advisor to partner engineering leaders and executives, and you will turn what you learn into patterns and playbooks that make every future integration faster and better.

Responsibilities

Technical ownership of strategic integrations: Serve as the technical lead for strategic ISV and technology partners building product integrations with Claude. Own the technical plan from use-case definition and scoping through build, launch, and post-launch iteration.
Integration architecture: Advise partners on how to expose their platform to Claude, including MCP server design, tool and API surface design for large platforms, authentication and admin onboarding, permissions, and plugin and skill structure. Be opinionated about the patterns that lead to the best experience for joint customers.
Evaluations and quality: Design and run evaluations of partner integrations against the use cases that matter most to joint customers. Turn results into concrete, prioritized feedback for partner engineering teams and hold a high quality bar before launch.
Hands-on prototyping: Build prototypes, demos, and reference skills that show partners the art of the possible, accelerate their build, and contribute to product improvements.
Launch readiness: Partner with Product, Partnerships, Marketing, and GTM teams to get integrations launch-ready on partner-driven timelines such as customer conferences and product events, and support partners and early customers through launch.
Product and research feedback loop: Act as the connective tissue between partners and Anthropic's Product, Engineering, and Research teams. Surface integration gaps and platform requirements, help shape the roadmap for how Claude works with third-party software, and bring early capabilities to partners.
Executive technical relationships: Build trusted relationships with partner CTOs, product leaders, and engineering leads. Explain technical tradeoffs and Anthropic's point of view clearly to technical and executive audiences alike.
Scale what works: Codify reference architectures, integration best practices, evaluation approaches, self-serve guidance, and playbooks so each new technology partnership starts from a stronger foundation, and help enable account teams and the broader partner ecosystem.
Joint customer success: Support account teams on strategic joint customers adopting partner integrations, and serve as an escalation point for complex technical issues.

You may be a good fit if you have

8+ years of experience in technical customer-facing or partner-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Partner Engineer, Developer Relations Engineer, or Technical Account Manager, or as a software engineer on platform, API, or integrations work
A track record of leading complex technical integrations with ISVs or technology partners, from solution design through launch
Deep experience with APIs, platform integration, and enterprise SaaS architecture, including authentication and authorization models, permissions, and admin experience
Hands-on familiarity with LLM applications and agentic tooling, such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP), tool use, agents, and evaluation frameworks
Strong coding ability; you can build prototypes, write evals, and work in a real codebase (comfort with Python or TypeScript expected)
Exceptional ability to build relationships with and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders, including C-suite executives and engineering leaders
Product sense, and the judgment to know when to push a partner toward a better design and when to adapt to their constraints
Comfort operating in early-stage, ambiguous environments where the playbook doesn't exist yet, and a track record of building structure as you go
Excitement for engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities
A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed
Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary

$240,000—$315,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education:
Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study:
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience:
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy:
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship:
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California:
We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us.
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How We're Different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

new_jobs.title: Principal Engineer - Agentic Platform
new_jobs.description:
Our Engineering organisation is scaling its AI Engineering capabilities under new leadership, creating an opportunity to build the next generation of AI at Rapid7. We’re looking for Principal AI Engineers to join us and help shape what comes next by defining and influencing the technical direction of our LLM and agentic AI systems. As a Principal AI Engineer, you’ll raise the bar for engineering standards, and build truly cutting edge greenfield solutions that deliver real impact for our Global customers. Through your technical leadership and mentoring, you’ll help shape our product and platform investments and influence how we build and scale AI across the organisation.

About The Team

Rapid7's AI Engineering team builds the AI that powers our security platform. We are AI engineers and applied scientists who take models from research to production, combining open-source and frontier LLMs, AI agents, and fast predictive models with more than 20 years of Rapid7 security expertise. Our work drives core use cases across Detection and Response, such as alert triage, threat investigation, and automated response, and Exposure and Remediation, such as vulnerability prioritization, attack surface risk assessment, and guided remediation. Together, these help customers stop threats faster and fix what matters most.

About The Role

As a Principal Engineer on the Agentic Platform, you will set the technical vision for how Rapid7 runs AI agents safely in production. You will own the architecture of the runtime that executes agents and their tools, including sandboxing, isolation, identity, permissions, and the full agent lifecycle from build to retirement. Agents in our products take actions inside customer environments, so the platform has to make those actions safe, observable, reversible, and affordable at scale. You will make the key calls on the platform's design and stay hands-on with the hardest problems. Specifically your focus will be to:

Define the architecture and technical roadmap for the agentic platform across Detection and Response and Exposure and Remediation
Design the secure runtime that executes agents and tools, including sandboxed code and tool execution, resource limits, and isolation between agents, tenants, and customer environments
Own the agent lifecycle: packaging, versioning, deployment, staged rollout, rollback, scaling, and retirement, with clear ownership and change control for every agent in production
Build identity and access controls for agents, including per-agent identities, least-privilege credentials, scoped and short-lived tokens, and policy enforcement on every tool call
Implement graduated autonomy: recommend-only, approve-to-act, and autonomous modes per action type, with guardrails, blast-radius limits, human approval flows, and a kill switch
Make agent behavior observable and auditable, with tracing of every model call, tool call, and action, along with the evidence and reasoning behind each decision, and support for replay and rollback
Defend the agent itself against prompt injection, tool abuse, data exfiltration, privilege escalation, and sandbox escape, and run adversarial testing as part of the release process
Establish evals as the release gate for every agent we ship, including safety, policy compliance, and regression evals that run before any agent version reaches production
Drive reliability, latency, and cost of agent execution at scale, including scheduling, concurrency, queuing, and capacity planning for long-running workflows
Set engineering standards for building, testing, and operating agents across teams, and lead design reviews that resolve the hardest technical trade-offs
Mentor Staff and Senior engineers and shape product and platform investment

The Skills And Qualities You’ll Bring Include

13+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years building platforms for production agentic AI systems, secure compute, or developer platforms
A track record of architecting platforms used across multiple teams or products
Secure runtime and isolation: deep expertise in sandboxing and isolation technologies such as containers, gVisor, Firecracker or microVMs, WebAssembly, and Linux security primitives (namespaces, cgroups, seccomp)

The Distinguished AI Engineer
is the hands-on technical lead for our enterprise AI platform in healthcare, responsible for designing, building, and scaling production-grade AI capabilities supporting machine learning, generative AI, and AI agents. This senior individual contributor role is for a technical expert who develops AI capabilities directly while influencing architecture, security posture, delivery models, and engineering practices across the organization. The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise with strong business acumen and has a proven track record of building reusable AI services at scale in complex, regulated enterprise environments. This is not a pure research or management role; we are looking for a hands-on builder who can help modernize how AI solutions are developed and deployed.

The ideal candidate also works directly with vendors and makes sound buy, build, and integrate decisions across commercial and open-source AI solutions, selecting the right approach based on business need, security and regulatory requirements, speed to value, and long-term maintainability.

How You Will Make An Impact

Design, develop, and deploy enterprise AI solutions spanning traditional machine learning, generative AI, and agentic AI systems.
Architect and deliver scalable, resilient AI solutions leveraging technologies such as agentic systems, large language models (LLMs), distributed systems, and event-driven architectures.
Serve as a senior hands-on contributor, technical leader, and subject matter expert across the AI development lifecycle
Build reusable AI services, frameworks, accelerators, and reference architectures leveraged across multiple teams and use cases

Define enterprise-wide technical direction, including architecture patterns, integration standards, and reusable platform capabilities.
Lead AI-driven modernization of legacy systems through automated code transformation, service decomposition, and continuous optimization.
Design and implement AI-enabled software development lifecycle (SDLC) practices to improve engineering velocity and quality.
Establish technical standards, governance frameworks, and best practices for AI systems, including monitoring, evaluation, and responsible AI.
Partner with engineering teams and stakeholders to enable adoption of AI-assisted development and drive continuous improvement in system performance and productivity.
Provide technical leadership and mentorship while influencing enterprise technology decisions through deep expertise and hands-on engineering.

Requires a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field and a minimum of 15 years of experience in software engineering, deep expertise in distributed systems and large-scale architecture, or any combination of education and experience, which would provide an equivalent background.
Experience delivering production-grade AI/ML systems at scale, building agentic systems or complex LLM-based applications, modernizing large, complex legacy systems, and delivering high-quality systems also required.

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

Purpose

Are you a builder who loves turning real business problems into working AI solutions?

As a Senior AI Enablement Engineer, you'll be a hands-on engineer working at the intersection of our business teams and enterprise AI platform. You'll partner closely with business teams to understand how they work, frame the right problem, and rapidly turn ideas into working AI solutions.

You'll iterate from early concepts to production-representative prototypes and reference implementations, validating business value, technical feasibility, and the path to production while meeting the bank's security, observability, privacy, and model risk standards.

This role suits someone who is outcome-driven, technically curious, comfortable with ambiguity, and motivated by seeing solutions adopted and making a measurable difference.

What You'll Do

Business partnership and problem framing

Work side by side with business teams to understand their workflows, pain points, and goals, and identify where AI can create the most value.
Frame each use case around user needs by defining the problem, success measures, and expected outcomes before building.
Start with the smallest solution that can demonstrate value, test it early with real users, and iterate based on feedback.
Keep stakeholders engaged through frequent demos and tight feedback loops so solutions solve the right problem and drive adoption.

AI enablement engineering and rapid prototyping

Design and build proofs of concept, prototypes, and reference implementations across traditional ML, generative AI, small language models, and agentic AI. Choose the simplest design that meets business, cost, latency, and risk requirements.
Translate business requirements into clear technical designs, including data flows, integrations, non-functional requirements, and the path to production.
Build RAG and knowledge retrieval solutions, including chunking strategies, embeddings, vector stores, hybrid search, reranking, and session and long-term memory patterns.
Design and prototype agentic workflows involving tool calling, structured outputs, multi-step orchestration, state management, human-in-the-loop patterns, and integrations with enterprise APIs and systems.
Work hands-on with Databricks, MLflow, feature engineering, and model serving capabilities.
Build reusable starter kits, templates, accelerators, and reference patterns so each new use case can move faster than the last.
Instrument AI solutions for end-to-end observability using OpenTelemetry GenAI tracing, structured logging, and cost and latency monitoring.
Build evaluation harnesses using offline and online evaluations, golden datasets, LLM-as-judge techniques, regression gates in CI/CD, and quality, hallucination, and accuracy tracking.
Prepare technical artifacts required for architecture, privacy, security, and model risk reviews.
Use enterprise AI platform capabilities where appropriate and share real-world friction points, feature gaps, and recurring patterns with Platform Engineering.

What You'll Bring

7+ years of experience in software engineering, ML engineering, AI engineering, or data engineering, including 1+ year experience delivering generative AI solutions into production environments.
Strong Python skills, including asynchronous programming, REST/FastAPI design, testing, and maintainable software engineering practices; strong working knowledge of SQL and Spark.
Experience with LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering, and AI evaluation techniques.
Experience with LLM and agent orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, Google ADK, or similar frameworks.
Experience with containerized application development and cloud-native delivery using Docker, Kubernetes (GKE or AKS), Git, and CI/CD.
Experience across Azure and GCP, including managed AI services such as Azure AI Foundry and Vertex AI.
Working knowledge of IAM, secrets management, AI guardrails, observability, and secure application development.

How You Work

You bring a user-focused, outcome-driven mindset and care about adoption and measurable impact, not only shipping code.
You turn ambiguous business problems into clear technical solutions and explain architectures, trade-offs, risks, and recommendations in plain language.
You are comfortable working through ambiguity and iterating quickly.
You exercise sound engineering judgment about when to experiment, when to simplify, and when a solution is mature enough to move forward.
You guide other engineers, contribute reusable patterns, and raise the technical quality of the team.

Nice to have

Experience in banking, financial services, or another regulated industry.
Experience building and operationalizing ML/AI solutions on Databricks, including MLflow, Unity Catalog, feature engineering, model serving, and model lifecycle management.
Experience with GitHub Actions, GitOps, Argo CD, MCP, OpenTelemetry, or Terraform.

Relevant certifications are an asset, including Databricks Machine Learning Professional, Microsoft Azure AI Engineer, Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer, or Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD).

Experience building production AI applications using agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, AWS Bedrock Agents, or CrewAI
Experience owning application features end to end, from requirements clarification and technical design through implementation, testing, deployment, and operational support

Experience with professional development practices, including Git, code reviews, automated testing, debugging, documentation, dependency management, and CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, or Jenkins
Experience developing and deploying containerized applications in cloud environments using platforms such as Docker or Kubernetes

Bachelor’s degree

The Air Dominance & Strike team at Anduril develops aerial and multi-domain robotic systems. The team also develops Lattice for Mission Autonomy, Anduril’s premier software platform that enables masses of Fury, Barracuda, and other first and third party robots to collaborate across various missions. We are looking for a Senior AI Infrastructure Engineer to build, scale, and optimize the end-to-end machine learning platform that powers Anduril’s autonomous systems.

You will build and operate the infrastructure required to train, evaluate, host, and serve complex AI models (including LLMs, computer vision, and RL agents) across cloud environments and air-gapped, edge-deployed networks. Company Description

Air is the leader in Enterprise Readiness. Our mission is to establish readiness as a real-time condition that is continuously achieved. Today, a dangerous Readiness Gap exists between what the front line needs and what is delivered. Our AI-native platform, Air Enterprise Readiness, aligns development, production, delivery, and sustainment into one coordinated execution system for government agencies and industrial suppliers. By revealing true capacity, exposing real constraints, coordinating resources, and executing at the speed of operational demands, the front line gets what it needs to succeed.

Job Description

We are seeking a mission-driven AI Engineer to join our AI Enablement team and advance our mission to deliver Enterprise Readiness across the organization. This role focuses on designing, developing, deploying, and continuously improving AI agents and agentic workflows that meaningfully increase employee productivity and operational effectiveness.

You will build production-grade agentic systems capable of executing complex, multi-step tasks, integrating with enterprise applications, retrieving and reasoning over organizational knowledge, and coordinating tools and workflows. You will also design and evaluate the underlying agent harnesses, execution environments, and retrieval infrastructure needed to make these systems reliable, secure, and effective in production.

Working across Product, Engineering, Operations, and Customer Success, you will apply modern AI technologies and rigorous engineering practices to automate high-value workflows, reduce operational costs, and accelerate organizational execution.

We Are Looking For Engineers Who Can Demonstrate Hands-on Experience Building And Improving LLM-powered Systems, With Particular Emphasis On The Following Capabilities

Agent Frameworks and Harness Development: Experience building agents using modern open-source frameworks and extensible harnesses, including Pi (pi.dev), LangGraph, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, PydanticAI, or comparable technologies. Familiarity with agent execution loops, tool interfaces, context management, state persistence, and extensible runtime architectures.
Agent Harness Engineering: Experience developing, extending, and evaluating agent harnesses, including custom tools, skills, execution environments, session management, sandboxing, recovery mechanisms, and orchestration. Ability to adapt existing open-source frameworks to specialized enterprise workflows.
Agentic Evaluations and Benchmarking: Hands-on experience designing and implementing agent evaluations, task-based benchmarks, regression tests, and execution trace analysis. Familiarity with open-source evaluation and observability tools such as Inspect AI, Langfuse, Arize Phoenix, or promptfoo.
Agent Lifecycle and Orchestration: Experience designing, deploying, and operating production-grade agents, including planning, tool use, state and memory management, multi-step task execution, and monitoring.
Enterprise Retrieval and Context Engineering: Experience integrating agents with enterprise search, hybrid retrieval, vector databases, knowledge graphs, and structured data sources to provide accurate, relevant, and access-controlled context.
Agent Development Tooling: Experience with modern AI development environments, SDKs, MCP-compatible integrations, reusable Agent Skills, and coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex.

Strong Candidates Have

Experience developing agentic applications that automate meaningful business workflows, including research, analysis, data synthesis, coding, and multi-system task execution.
Experience building reusable agent skills, tool interfaces, and integrations using Model Context Protocol (MCP) or comparable architectures.
Experience with hybrid retrieval systems combining lexical search, semantic/vector retrieval, reranking, or knowledge graph-based retrieval (GraphRAG).
Familiarity with knowledge representation, structured data models, and ontologies used to organize and retrieve enterprise knowledge.
Hands-on experience with multi-agent coordination, task routing, planning, and tool orchestration.
Experience using AI coding agents and development environments (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, or Google Antigravity) to improve software engineering productivity.
Familiarity with enterprise identity and access management, role-based access controls (RBAC), and secure integration of AI systems with internal applications and data.
Experience operating in fast-moving, ambiguous environments and delivering solutions from initial prototype through production deployment.

This role is a full-time position located out of our office in Arlington, VA or Pittsburgh, PA.

This role may require up to 25% travel.

Scope of Responsibilities

Design, develop, deploy, and maintain AI agents and agentic workflows that automate complex internal business processes and improve employee productivity.
Build and optimize agent harnesses, including execution environments, tool-calling infrastructure, context and memory management, state persistence, and mechanisms for recovery, retries, and human oversight.
Design, implement, and maintain automated evaluation pipelines and benchmarks for agents, harnesses, prompts, skills, and tools. Use task-level metrics, execution traces, and regression tests to systematically improve reliability and effectiveness.
Develop reusable agent skills, MCP-compatible tools, APIs, and integrations with enterprise systems, enabling agents to interact securely with organizational applications, workflows, and knowledge sources.
Design and integrate context engineering, memory, and retrieval capabilities, including hybrid search, structured data access, and knowledge graph-based retrieval where appropriate.
Instrument and monitor production agent systems, assessing task completion, failure modes, latency, inference and tool costs, and operational reliability. Contribute to testing, deployment, and continuous improvement practices.
Collaborate with Product, Engineering, GTM, and Operations teams to identify high-value automation opportunities, translate business requirements into technical solutions, and measure their operational impact.

Qualifications

U.S. Citizenship is required.
Bachelor's, Master's, or Doctorate degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field.

Required Skills

Minimum 3 years of experience building and deploying machine learning, AI, or LLM-powered systems in production environments.
Demonstrated experience developing LLM applications or agentic workflows that integrate models, tools, APIs, and external data sources.
Strong software engineering skills in Python, including API development, debugging, testing, and designing maintainable production systems.
Working knowledge of modern LLM architectures, prompting and context engineering, function/tool calling, and techniques for improving agent performance and reliability.
Familiarity with agent evaluation methodologies, automated testing, and performance measurement.
Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure (e.g., AWS, GCP) and deploying AI applications and services.
Proficiency with Git, collaborative software development practices, and familiarity with CI/CD pipelines.
Ability to work independently, rapidly investigate new technologies, and deliver high-quality software in a fast-paced engineering environment.

Desired Skills

Current possession of a U.S. security clearance, or the ability to obtain one with our sponsorship.
